extracted.description: This drink originated in Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada. This version adds lime juice myself for the extra zing. The primary flavours are coconut and pineapple.
instruction_lines: Pour the rum, amaretto, lime juice, pineapple juice, and cranberry juice into a tall glass with ice; stir.
